positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Co-Architect migration efforts of high value system to Supply API and Backend.
Design and Implement REST API calls in Java8 and Java11.
Design and Implement Mybatis queries between an API and MySQL DBs.
Use Liquibase (XML) to modify MySQL DBs.
Maintain CICD pipeline using Screwdriver, Docker, Docker Compose, and multiple components from aws to implement a microservice architecture.
Included in meetings to discuss Open Source Version of Screwdriver and its feature road map.
Instruct other teams on Screwdriver and AWS ECR.
Hand off microservice stack to another team with complete documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Implement REST API calls in Java8 and Java11.
Design and Implement Mybatis and Hibernate queries between an API and Oracle and MySQL DBs.
Scrum Master my team and lead them through the grooming and design of stories.
Lead the designing and maintaining of a new CICD pipeline using Screwdriver, Docker, Docker Compose, and multiple components from aws to implement a microservice architecture.
Implement a fresh microservice architecture using Java11 API and Scala backend.
Instruct other teams on Screwdriver and AWS ECR.
Migrate AdServer repo from BitBucket to GitHub. Modify and Create scripts to keep Jira/BitBucket/Jenkins functionality in Jire/GitHub/Jenkins environment.
Migrate features and tests from Yahoo API to Verizon Supply API.
Run meetings on the importance of keeping testing standards in a non-QA stack.

company.name: Advertising.com, A Division of AOL Platforms

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Thoroughly tests Advertising.com technology products and applications including core ad serving platforms, bidding systems, client systems, etc.
Owns tasks in test plan development and automation testing.
Builds automated testing framework.
Participates in design and code reviews as appropriate.
Identifies and documents bugs within assigned projects.
Analyzes and troubleshoots issues with software and environment.
Installs code into QA environment and maintains environment integrity.
Works directly with development and system administrators in troubleshooting problems.
Works with other teams on integration and end-to-end testing.
Supports production code installs as appropriate.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Using Jmeter and Selenium to create very in depth automated test suites. These test suites are used for doing a vast amount of Regression, Security, Acceptance, and Performance Testing.
Write comprehensive test plans to explain the testing done on projects.
All bugs found during testing products are tracked using Jira
Write Python Scripts to perform large scale server maintenance and software deployment.
Train Product Technicians how to complete site surveys and install servers in new and existing racks. How to troubleshoot complicated networks to fix issues with live video streams.
Train Testers how to use Selenium IDE and Jmeter. Mentor them on SDLC and STLC.

projects.title: Python Framework to Automate API Testing
projects.description:
Proposed a better API testing method. Instead of using soapUI framework as our automation testing we will use Python Design automation test suite.
I am in charge a design an in house automation framework using Python.
I am also training the engineers that are unfamiliar with Python and Automation.
The Framework will be designed so it can be across multiple teams with each team creating their own package that can be used by other teams if need be.
Integrate test suite into Jenkins
Other modules being integrated include Requests, pytest, pytest-xdist, cx_Oracle, PyMySQL
This Framework will also be responsible for Performance testing the backend APIs
